ontology_metadata.title: Frozen SGG Benchmark Shared Relationship Evaluation Ontology
normalization_rules: Subject/object directionality is strictly preserved across all normalized views.
Predictions and ground truth outside the target vocabulary view are filtered without reversing endpoints.

strict_core_4way.description: Strict 4-dataset common vocabulary requiring EXACT or proven SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT across all 4 datasets without broader generalization.

extended_core_4way.description: Extended 4-dataset common vocabulary including documented ACCEPTABLE_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION mappings ('looking at' from read/reading, 'playing' from playing with).

tri_dataset_core.description: 20-predicate vocabulary supported by VG150 and at least two other benchmark datasets (with 17 predicates unanimously supported across VG150, PSG, and IndoorVG).
